purpose: Reorganize existing test evidence around hidden world change, public observation, interpretation, interaction, physical action and fresh verification.
scope: Selected existing non-render tests plus explicitly retained historical render references; no new runtime capability.
important_limit: These tests span separate fixtures. Passing them does not demonstrate one autonomous end-to-end agent or agreement with real PV hardware.

existing_test_records.checks: Private source step changes irradiance, electrical state and light at the event endpoint; previous interval energy and temperature remain continuous.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Agent discovery or physical-panel accuracy.

existing_test_records.checks: Matched control/treatment response agrees with separately implemented electrical and thermal reference.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: A trained or reasoning agent identifies the cause.

existing_test_records.checks: A changed display label cannot mask a wrong electrical response.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: All possible model errors or empirical validity.

existing_test_records.checks: A one-tick source/energy ordering error fails the response checker.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Full timestep and spatial convergence.

existing_test_records.checks: Lower source slows heating; treatment can still warm while staying cooler than control.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Real panel thermal constants.

existing_test_records.checks: Independent reference integration is stable under its predeclared step-halving check.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Convergence of every production scenario.

existing_test_records.checks: A scalar captured before the change retains its old value and timestamp after delivery.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Agent detection of a change.

existing_test_records.checks: Wrong-time values fail even when the channel label is correct.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: An agent knows which packet is relevant.

existing_test_records.checks: Missing sensor coverage is detected.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Real acquisition reliability.

existing_test_records.checks: Future evidence cannot appear in an earlier containing observation.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Adversarial process isolation.

existing_test_records.checks: Seeded generator samples satisfy declared scale and cross-channel checks.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Measured instrument error distributions.

existing_test_records.checks: Missing samples retain capture metadata and cannot present invented values.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Agent reasoning about absent evidence.

existing_test_records.checks: Actual MuJoCo images change after the source event while old frames retain old light.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Calibrated radiometry or visual understanding.

existing_test_records.checks: Actual views distinguish framing, narrow-screen occlusion and reachable translation.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Agent-selected active perception or source shadows.

existing_test_records.checks: B1 chooses the best measured V times I of its fixed probe schedule and subsequently seeks newer verification.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Causal diagnosis, pre-action numerical predictions or adaptive choice of experiment.

existing_test_records.checks: B1 stops if required probe evidence is missing, stale or not simultaneous.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: General belief revision or optimal abstention.

existing_test_records.checks: B1 does not accept old readings as verification of a new setting.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: An inferred model of a novel fault.

existing_test_records.checks: Prediction/belief records obey format, coverage and numeric rules.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Correct or calibrated predictions: B0/B1 do not populate predictions or probabilities.

existing_test_records.checks: Free-text questions are not constrained to legacy diagnosis labels.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Useful question generation.

existing_test_records.checks: Completed-parent follow-up and identical retry accounting are correct.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: The follow-up is selected because of a response.

existing_test_records.checks: Three-request shared allowance counts follow-ups and nonanswers.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Value of information or efficient source choice.

existing_test_records.checks: Human/internet deadlines use wall time and do not add frozen-world energy.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Live source response latency or real-time energy yield.

existing_test_records.checks: Decision overhead advances physics; pending information then freezes state and sensor/event queues exactly.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: A real plant can be paused.

existing_test_records.checks: Recorded adapter matches the full request, with honest provenance.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Internet connectivity or an actual participant exchange.

existing_test_records.checks: Information references link a separately submitted physical action to its public outcome and replay.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Evidence attribution alone establishes that evidence caused or improved a decision.

existing_test_records.checks: Acknowledged load requests apply after delay/slew and need fresh measurements.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Measured electronic-load dynamics.

existing_test_records.checks: Dropped actuation is not falsely reported applied; retry does not repeat costs.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Agent finds the underlying actuator fault.

existing_test_records.checks: Cancelled delayed command cannot apply later.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Hardware stop certification.

existing_test_records.checks: Inhibited camera command cannot fabricate target pose or a settled capture.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: A physical mechanical jam or a learned self-model.

existing_test_records.checks: An advertised zero-width rail capability is enforced before motion.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Hidden capability discovery: rail lock is publicly advertised.

existing_test_records.checks: External recommendations cannot expand the physical action limits.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: All prompt-injection attacks against a future model.

existing_test_records.checks: Missing/stale readings cannot verify a requested load.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Physical agreement or correct causal explanation.

existing_test_records.checks: B0/B1 stop on incomplete, rejected or failed action feedback.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: General autonomous recovery planning.

existing_test_records.checks: A completion label without actual encoder evidence cannot pass B1 verification.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Sensor calibration on a real rig.

existing_test_records.checks: Information requests reserve resources for Finish and its two-second verification tail.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Correct diagnosis.

existing_test_records.checks: Fixed scripted information/probe fixture has honest provenance, measured action confirmation, exact replay and artifact hashes.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: One autonomous loop: the authored driver finishes unresolved and calls no live service.

existing_test_records.checks: Actual RGB B1 sequence links images, probe, chosen voltage and newer scalar verification.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Causal diagnosis, image interpretation or real source retrieval.

existing_test_records.checks: Source schedule stays private and the same recorded physical actions replay exactly.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Independent agent rerun or cross-GPU pixel equality.

existing_test_records.checks: Injected private schedule in the public task fails the evidence check.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: All covert leakage channels.

existing_test_records.checks: Policy receives a serialized copy of public task/history.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: OS isolation against malicious local code.

existing_test_records.checks: Transport receives only the public request, not environment/private state.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: That a trusted caller cannot type secrets into free text.

existing_test_records.checks: External text remains inert; a separate typed physical decision is required.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Semantic robustness of an unimplemented LLM agent.

existing_test_records.checks: Unknown/foreign evidence references reject without executing actions.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Truthfulness of an attributed answer.

existing_test_records.checks: Incomplete or reordered replay histories reject.
existing_test_records.does_not_establish: Replay is a new independent decision trial.

planned_tests.question: Does an agent notice a source response using only delivered observations?
planned_tests.design: Give the same public task in control and source-step runs. Hide schedule and evaluator truth; retain reference irradiance. Freeze a change-detection window and false-alarm control.
planned_tests.expected: Detect after informative capture/delivery, not before; justify with reference/current evidence; no compulsory outside query.

planned_tests.question: Does the agent distinguish lower source illumination from an observation/view problem?
planned_tests.design: Use independently validated source-step data and existing camera-view occlusion fixtures. Keep view obstruction separate from illumination.
planned_tests.expected: A dark/blocked view alone does not prove reduced PV illumination; consult electrical/reference evidence.

planned_tests.question: Can a meaningful human reply change the next question or bounded experiment?
planned_tests.design: Freeze an identical public history, then offer supported contextual replies with different actionable information and an irrelevant control reply. Declare acceptable branches before running.
planned_tests.expected: Relevant evidence can alter a justified branch; irrelevant or unsupported text does not force an action. Attribution alone is insufficient.

planned_tests.question: Does external technical information improve test design without becoming an oracle?
planned_tests.design: Use a frozen manual excerpt about measurement timing or probe interpretation, plus an unavailable/conflicting variant. The source does not reveal hidden scenario labels.
planned_tests.expected: Choose an allowed, discriminating test or remain unresolved; cite applicable source and limitations.

planned_tests.question: Does the agent respect its actual capabilities and reconsider failed action?
planned_tests.design: Use advertised rail lock, budget scarcity, and existing hidden load-drop profiles. Separate public incapability from uncertain actuation failure.
planned_tests.expected: Avoid impossible advertised moves; after unconfirmed load change, seek valid evidence or stop, not report recovery.

planned_tests.question: Does a pre-action prediction survive a new measured response?
planned_tests.design: Record predicted direction or bounded quantity/time window before a voltage probe, using public information only; score later fresh V/I and any declared uncertainty.
planned_tests.expected: Correctly distinguish successful action, informative evidence, causal inference and unsupported diagnosis; allow not_predictable.

planned_tests.question: Does adaptive interaction add value over a frozen sequence?
planned_tests.design: Compare declared agent and fixed sequence on the same few cases, source collection, observation channels, request/physical budgets and exogenous conditions.
planned_tests.expected: Report episode decision quality, verification, unresolved outcomes and raw resource costs, including zero benefit; no universal superiority claim.

planned_tests.question: Do digital intervention responses match real panel responses?
planned_tests.design: Identify a physical counterpart, calibrate only designated data, freeze model and alignment, then test held-out load/light/motion changes with measured uncertainty.
planned_tests.expected: Report absolute and before/after residuals, timing error and decision-relevant equivalence margins; software tolerances are not physical uncertainty.
